components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Vibrant gradient button with hover lift
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8B5CF6, #06B6D4); border: none; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 99px; font: 600 12px 'Inter', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-chip-up { color: #10b981; background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); } .ds-chip-up::before { background: #10b981; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #10b981; }

narrative.overview: A high-end, contemporary dark mode that feels premium and state-of-the-art. It utilizes subtle glassmorphism (translucent surfaces with background blur), deep ambient gradients, and crisp geometric sans-serif typography.
dos: Do use backdrop-filter: blur(12px) on surfaces to maintain the glassmorphic feel.
Do use negative letter-spacing (-0.02em) on headings for a tighter, premium look.
donts: Don't use solid, opaque backgrounds for cards; always let the ambient background glow show through slightly.
Don't use sharp 0px corners on interactive elements.
